profile_text: With a focus on transportation and supply chain management, this Düsseldorf-based logistics provider has achieved remarkable growth of 3400% since its baseline, driven by its expertise in streamlining logistics operations for clients. As a specialist in managing complex supply chains, the company's services are in high demand, enabling it to expand its workforce to 35 employees by 2024. By leveraging its strategic location and logistical expertise, the company is well-positioned to continue its rapid expansion in the European market.
